65 likes, 10 comments - ellasrecipebook_ on October 13, 2026: "better than a sausage mcmuffin? 👀🍳

your favourite breakfast sandwich, but homemade 🤝 juicy chicken sausage patties, melty cheese and that ketchup mustard combo. basically, mcdonald’s but make it at home. 🤌🏼

CHICKEN SAUSAGE MUFFIN 🍳

Macros per sandwich: 316 kcal | 30g protein (varies with add ons)

Ingredients (4 sandwiches)

Sausage patties
• 450g chicken mince
• 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika
• 1 tsp black pepper
• ¾ tsp salt
• ½ tsp chilli flakes
• 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
• ½ tbsp maple syrup (optional)

Per sandwich
• 1 English muffin
• 2 sausage patties
• ½ slice cheese
• Ketchup + yellow mustard (non negotiable!)

Method

1. Mix mince with all seasonings and Worcestershire sauce.
2. Shape into 8 thin patties.
3. Cook in a non stick pan for 3–4 mins per side, until fully cooked. No oil needed if the mince has enough fat.
4. Toast muffin, melt cheese over patties and assemble with ketchup and mustard. Add an egg if you like!

Pro tips 🌟

1. Maple syrup adds that sweet savoury sausage flavour. An egg boosts protein and satiety. Skip the butter!
2. No English muffins? Use a burger bun, soft bread or whole wheat bun. Toast for a golden outside.
3. Meal prep: Assemble with bread, patties and cheese, without sauces or veggies. Wrap and freeze, then reheat thoroughly and add sauces fresh.
4. You can freeze cooked patties separately too for quick sandwiches anytime!

P.S. 👀 We experimented with larger, thicker patties, so yours may look bigger than the ones in the video. Flatten them more for a classic McMuffin style.

save this for your next breakfast craving 💌

(chicken sausage mcmuffin, high protein breakfast sandwich, homemade sausage muffin, easy breakfast recipe, healthy mcdonalds copycat)".

105 likes, 10 comments - ellasrecipebook_ on October 8, 2026: "🌭 FEEDING ADI: CHILLI CHEESE HOT DOG 🌶️🧀
Today on #FeedingAdi -  a juicy chicken chilli, a proper frankfurter, melted cheddar + jalapeños… basically everything you want in a hot dog. 🌭🤌🏻

450 CAL | 44G PROTEIN | 42G CARBS | 14G FAT
Makes 4

FOR THE HOT DOG
• 4 hot dog buns
• 4 frankfurters 
• Cheese for topping
• Jalapeños + red paprika
• Mustard + ketchup, as desired

FOR THE CHICKEN CHILLI
• 400g chicken mince
• 2 tbsp minced garlic
• 300g tinned tomatoes
• 2 tbsp Cajun seasoning — I use @urbanplatter.in 
• 1 tbsp oregano
• Chilli flakes, to taste
• Basil, to taste
• Salt + pepper, to taste

METHOD
Add the chicken mince straight to a hot pan (no oil needed). Break it up and cook until it starts to brown.
Add the minced garlic and seasonings. Mix well and cook until the mince is nicely coated and fragrant.
Add the tinned tomatoes and let everything cook down until you have a thick, juicy chicken chilli. If using fresh tomatoes, you’ll need to cook it considerably longer to get the same consistency.
Hollow out the centre of each bun, leaving enough around the edges to hold everything together. This brings each bun down to around 60-65g.
Toast the buns, add the frankfurter, cheese and pile on the hot chicken chilli.
Finish with jalapeños, red paprika, mustard and ketchup.

PRO TIP: Hollow out the centre of your bun! You get a lighter bun and way more room to stuff in the chicken chilli, cheese and toppings. Honestly, it just makes for a much better hot dog. 🌭

Save this for your next fakeaway night ❤️

(chilli cheese hot dog, chicken mince hot dog, Feeding Adi, homemade hot dog, high protein hot dog, easy dinner recipe, fakeaway recipe, chicken mince recipe, cheesy hot dog, hot dog recipe)".

Kerala-Inspired Coconut Curry Leaf Prawns

A little spicy, super fragrant and loaded with curry leaves  this one comes together so quickly and is SO good with a crispy dosa on the side.

355 KCAL | 22G PROTEIN | 20G FAT | 22G CARBS
Serves 2

INGREDIENTS

For the curry leaf paste
• ½ cup curry leaves + extra for garnish
• 1 tbsp oil
• ¼ tsp turmeric
• 6 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp grated coconut
• water for blending - don’t use too much 

For the prawns
• 200g prawns, peeled & deveined
• 1 tbsp Greek yogurt / hung curd
• 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
• ¼ tsp black pepper

For cooking
• 1 tsp coconut oil
• 1 tsp mustard seeds
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 onion, thinly sliced
• 2 green chillies, slit
• 1½ tsp coriander powder
• Salt
• Extra curry leaves

METHOD

1. Sauté curry leaves in oil until bright green and fragrant. Don’t let them brown.
2. Blend the curry leaves, turmeric, garlic and coconut with 1 tsp water until smooth.
3. Marinate the prawns with Greek yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and pepper.
4. Heat coconut oil and add mustard seeds. Once they pop, add onion and sauté until golden.
5. Add garlic, green chillies and coriander powder. Sauté for 30 seconds.
6. Add the prawns and toss for a minute.
7. Add the curry leaf paste, fresh curry leaves and salt. Toss and cook for 3–4 minutes, until the prawns are just cooked.
8. Finish with extra curry leaves and serve hot with a crispy dosa.

SAVE THIS FOR THE NEXT TIME YOU WANT SOMETHING THAT FEELS FANCY BUT TAKES 15 MINUTES 🤌🏽

PRO TIP: Don’t overcook the prawns — the second they’re opaque and curled, they’re done!

955 likes, 25 comments - ellasrecipebook_ on September 4, 2026: "FEEDING ADI — EP. 01 ✨♥️ 
Normal food. Better macros.

Chicken Steak in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
Adi wanted steak with mushroom sauce.
I wanted something that fit our goals.
So I made it my way.🥰 

323 kcal | 42g P | 17g C | 9g F
Serves 3

INGREDIENTS

Chicken Steak
* 450g chicken breast, flatten each breast for easy cooking
* 1 tsp garlic powder
* 1 tsp onion powder
* 1 tsp paprika
* ½ tsp dried parsley
* Salt & black pepper

Creamy Mushroom Sauce
* 200g button mushrooms, sliced
* 100g cremini mushrooms, sliced - not necessary can use normal button also 
* 1 onion, finely chopped
* 1 tsp olive oil
* 1 tsp Dijon mustard
* 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
* 1 tsp soy sauce
* ½ tsp garlic powder
* ½ tsp onion powder
* 200 - 250ml water
* 120g Greek yogurt - room temp - take it out 30 minutes before you start cooking 
* 1 tbsp cornflour
* 2 tbsp water
* Salt & black pepper

METHOD
Season the chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, dried parsley, salt and pepper.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add olive oil and sauté the onion. Add the button and cremini mushrooms and cook until softened and golden.
Add Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, garlic powder and onion powder. Mix well.
Add the water and bring to a simmer. Mix the cornflour with 2 tbsp water and stir into the sauce. Cook until slightly thickened.
Lower the heat. Mix a little of the warm sauce into the Greek yogurt first, then add it back into the pan and stir until creamy.
Plate the chicken and spoon the mushroom sauce generously over the top.
PRO TIP: Temper your Greek yogurt before adding it to the sauce so it stays smooth and creamy instead of splitting - temper is basically add a few tbsp of sauce to the yogurt.

Save this for the next time you want steak night without feeling like you’re eating diet food. 🤍

120 likes, 8 comments - ellasrecipebook_ on October 6, 2026: "SPINACH + CHERRY TOMATO SCRAMBLED EGGS 🍳🍅

My kind of lazy-girl breakfast — eggs, garlicky cherry tomatoes, wilted spinach and a little seasoning. Takes about 10 minutes and actually keeps you full.

Macros: ~300 kcal | ~20g protein
Serves: 1

Ingredients

* 3 eggs
* 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
* 1 packed cup spinach
* 2–3 garlic cloves, finely chopped
* 1 tsp olive oil
* Salt, to taste
* Black pepper, to taste
* ½ tsp chilli flakes
* ¼ tsp oregano
* 1 tbsp milk/water (optional, for softer eggs)

Method

1. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the garlic for 20–30 seconds.
2. Add cherry tomatoes, salt, pepper and chilli flakes. Cook until the tomatoes soften and start getting a little jammy.
3. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
4. Beat the eggs with a splash of milk/water and pour them in.
5. Keep the heat low and gently fold the eggs until just cooked and still soft.
6. Finish with oregano, black pepper and chilli flakes.

PRO TIP: Don’t overcook the eggs. Take them off the heat when they still look slightly underdone — they’ll finish cooking from the residual heat.

Save this for the next time you want a 10-minute breakfast that doesn’t taste like diet food. 🫶🏻

(spinach scrambled eggs, high protein breakfast, healthy breakfast, easy egg recipe, cherry tomato eggs, garlic eggs, quick breakfast, healthy recipes, protein breakfast)".

Makes: ~12 large meatballs
Serves: 3
Serving size: 4 meatballs + 100 g Caesar salad
Macros per serving:
358 kcal | 53 g protein | 12 g carbs | 13 g fat

Ingredients
For the meatballs
* 450 g chicken mince
* 1 tbsp minced garlic
* 2 tbsp grated Parmesan
* 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
* 1 tsp Dijon mustard
* ½ tsp soy sauce
* 1 tsp black pepper
* Salt, to taste
* ¼ cup breadcrumbs

For the Caesar dressing
* 250 g Greek yogurt
* 20 g grated Parmesan
* 1 tsp Dijon mustard
* 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
* 2 garlic cloves, minced
* Juice of ½ lemon
* Salt & black pepper, to taste
* Water, as needed

For the salad
* 300 g romaine lettuce
* Caesar dressing
* Extra Parmesan
* Freshly cracked black pepper

Method
1. Combine all the meatball ingredients and mix until just combined.
2. Shape into ~12 large meatballs.
3. Air fry at 180°C for 10 minutes, or until cooked through.

5. Chop the romaine and toss 100 g salad per serving with the dressing.
6. Plate 4 meatballs with 100 g Caesar salad per serving. Finish with Parmesan and freshly cracked pepper.

Pro tip: Don’t overmix the chicken mince - it’ll keep the meatballs tender and juicy.

92 likes, 18 comments - ellasrecipebook_ on September 17, 2026: "DAN DAN NOODLES 🍜
If you like spicy, saucy noodles, you NEED to make these.
510 CAL | 38G PROTEIN | 43G CARBS | 23G FAT
SERVES 3

INGREDIENTS
Noodles + greens
* 120g @masterchow.in udon noodles, raw
* 1 bunch bok choy (or spinach / any greens)
Chicken
* 450g @licious_foods chicken mince
* 1 tbsp ginger, chopped
* 1 tbsp garlic, chopped
* 1 tbsp soy sauce
* ½ tbsp oyster sauce
* 1 tbsp vinegar
* Salt + pepper
Dan Dan sauce
* 1½ tbsp garlic, finely chopped
* 1 tbsp chilli flakes
* 2 tbsp sesame seeds
* 1 tbsp sesame oil (15ml)
* 1 tbsp dark soy
* 1½ tbsp light soy
* 1 tbsp oyster sauce
* 2 tbsp rice wine vinegar
* 2½ tbsp peanut butter
* 1 tbsp schezuan sauce, adjust to taste
* ½ tbsp jaggery, optional
* ¼ cup vegetable stock or warm water
Garnish: spring onion greens + sesame seeds

METHOD
Poach the greens and cook the udon according to the packet. Set aside.
Cook the chicken mince, breaking it up well. Add ginger, garlic, soy, oyster sauce, vinegar, salt + pepper. Turn up the heat and cook until dry and slightly caramelised.
For the sauce, add garlic, chilli + sesame seeds to a bowl. Pour over hot sesame oil and let it sizzle for 15 seconds. Add remaining sauce ingredients and mix. Loosen with stock/warm water.
Layer sauce, noodles, chicken + greens in a bowl. Finish with spring onions + sesame seeds.

VEG ALTERNATIVES 🌱
Mushrooms: 500–600g, finely chopped. Cook until the moisture evaporates and they’re browned, then season as above.
Tofu: 300–350g firm tofu, crumbled and cooked until golden.
Paneer: 300–350g paneer, crumbled and lightly browned.
Traditionally Dan Dan noodles use Sichuan peppercorns — I didn’t have any, but these were still SO good. Chunky peanut butter is my preference for texture, but smooth works too.

SAVE this for your next noodle craving & SHARE it with someone who loves noodles! 🤍

(dan dan noodles, chicken mince, high protein dinner, easy dinner, weeknight dinner, noodle recipe, vegetarian noodles, mushroom noodles, tofu noodles, paneer noodles)".
